title: Copilot reflection and telemetry - pilot
description: Derived assessments and collection status. Synthetic smoke rows are labelled; real client collection and token accounting are not enabled yet.

options.content:
### Synthetic smoke pilot
Assessment rows labelled `synthetic_azure_model_smoke` are test fixtures, not real project work. Model inference is connected; native client collection and daily scheduling are **not installed**. Only reviewed derived summaries are published. Project IDs will use `personal/project` or `msft/project`; `synthetic/demo` is reserved for this smoke test. The time picker filters **assessment creation time**, not source-session time.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Outcome, Summary, Origin, Limitations, SessionEndedAt
| order by TimeGenerated desc

CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastAssessment=max(TimeGenerated), EligibleRowsVisible=count() by ProjectId, Origin
| extend MinutesSinceAssessment=datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastAssessment)
| order by LastAssessment desc

panels.title: Usage and reliability - not collecting yet

options.content:
Native OTel collector: **not installed**.

Project-level tokens, latency, errors, and delivery health are **unavailable**, not zero. They will be wired after one controlled client sample proves workspace identity and the correct accounting layer.

The Azure model smoke test's inference usage is local evaluation usage, not coding-session telemetry, and is intentionally excluded. An assessment timestamp does not prove the collector is healthy. This status panel is static until installation.
